notes.title: Core Piercer chapter 2, Ice World, has released.
notes.content:
This major update mainly adds a second chapter: Ice and Snow Polar Region

Different from the high temperature and high pressure in Chapter 1, this chapter belongs to the extremely low temperature environment.

In the ice and snow polar regions, the train is covered with heavy snow, and players need to use heating equipment to maintain the normal operation of the train. For unknown reasons, it is getting colder and colder under the ice layer, and the train without a heat source may be frozen. For the warmth of the polar regions, we have developed a stove compartment. With battery compartments of various sizes, it will be able to provide adequate protection for extremely low temperatures under the ice. Thermal insulation technology can also effectively prevent the loss of heat energy.

And for the slippery ice layer, we have made a large tracked car, which will be able to improve the grip of the car. However, the grip that one can provide is limited, so adventurers need to be equipped with an appropriate amount of tracked carriages to provide proper grip for the entire train.

Conditions for entering Chapter 2:
Players need to complete the gold mine mining task first, and sell the gold mine to the store to complete. New tracks will be built on the map. Click on the map sign next to the station to select other stations where the car will go.
After the player purchases the stove compartment and equips it, the heater switch will appear, and the player can decide whether to turn on the heater.

Rule adjustment:
1. For turbofan cars, the number of engine cars is changed to unlimited. The heavier the train will require more functional cars to maintain operation. The same applies to the newly added large-scale crawler carriages.
2. The price of liquid nitrogen is adjusted to 1000/1k (originally 5000/1k). One release will use a quantity that can last for 8 seconds. The heavier the train, the higher the demand. The storage capacity is displayed in the lower left corner and can be released by clicking with the mouse.
3. The temperature that all train cars can tolerate is 1500 degrees. When the temperature is exceeded, the cars will be burned, usually starting from the rear of the train.

Special effects
1. Snow train, the lower the temperature, the thicker the snow on the carriage.
2. Brake sound effect, liquid nitrogen release sound effect.

Bug fix:
1. All carriages burned, and the reborn train was abnormal.
2. The volume adjustment is abnormal.
3. Trade and refuel outside the station.

notes.title: v1.30 update released. The train dispatching field.
notes.content:
We like this game very much and will continue to be updated.
We already have a plan for the second chapter. The second chapter is expected to enter the era of electric trains with a whole new stratum. Please look forward to and support us. This update has a lot of content, so it took a long time. The update details are as follows:

1. In this version, we mainly added a train dispatching field, where players can adjust and configure the number and types of train cars, and can view the entire train. The total number of train cars can exceed 1,000 without an upper limit. However, the total weight of the train carriage will affect fuel consumption and increase the consumption of refrigerant.

2. Added 5 kinds of freight train cars, one kind of mobile refinery train cars. The refinery carriage can directly convert the dug crude oil into train fuel through the program, so that the train can extend the distance of movement. If you run out of oil, use the refinery train carriage!

3. The depth of the stratum content has been increased by 15km, and a new type of rift stratum has been added. In the rift valley, trains must follow the slope to climb up, but they can freely dig down.

4. There is a new magnetite mineral in the rift valley, and the corresponding rough mineral stone, which has a higher health value and corresponding mining tasks.

5. A new NPC appearance is adopted, and the dialogue interface has a clearer facial face.

notes.title: v1.296 Liquid nitrogen car
notes.content: Liquid nitrogen can be used to quickly cool train cars, but it is also relatively expensive. It is usually used in emergency. Similar to fuel, the more the number of cars, the greater the amount of liquid nitrogen used, so please reserve an appropriate amount.
